Why Study Chemistry?
The PhD in Chemistry program prepares students for many paths, from running a laboratory at a university, leading research teams in industry, or directing government research in health, defense, and more. Our renowned faculty work to increase understanding of the world and influence it for the better.
At UMBC, students with interests in a wide range of chemistry disciplines, such as medicinal chemistry, toxicology, imaging and sensors, computational chemistry, bioinorganic chemistry, and more can take a deep dive into research that aligns with their interests and goals, under the direct mentorship of expert faculty. Close collaborations with academic and government institutions in the region brighten students’ prospects for meaningful experiential learning options and career opportunities.

Ready to Apply?
1
Review Doctor of Philosophy in Chemistry Requirements
GRE is waived for Spring 2027.
GRE Advanced Chemistry Test not required
Undergraduate major in chemistry, biochemistry, or the biological sciences
International applicants are encouraged to apply for Fall admission (or to apply early if Spring admission is desired).
2
Start Your Graduate Admissions Application
Please note that application decisions can take 6-8 weeks after the program’s deadline, and depend on how many applications a department receives. You will receive an email once the department processes your decision letter. You will be able to see your decision letter by logging in to the application website. Your decision letter will be where the application checklist was. You may also check your recommendation statuses to send reminders or update contact information from the user page. If you are having trouble logging back in, you can recover your account.
3
Have Questions?
Please contact the appropriate Graduate School staff member for assistance, or contact our Main Office at gradschool@umbc.edu or 410-455-2537.
